description: Block another actor: self-sovereign, one record per (caller, blockedDid) under the caller's own repo, deterministic rkey = blockedDid (re-blocking is a no-op, not an accumulating record). Enforced server-side for NEW 1:1 DM creation (createConvo) and sealed message sending (sendSealed) — the blocked actor cannot start a new conversation with or sealed-message the blocker. Existing conversations and the plain (non-sealed) send path are NOT enforced yet — see aozora.pds.convo's create-convo docstring for why (resolving arbitrary convo membership to a single 'other party' isn't well-defined for groups; a follow-up, not silently promised here).
